source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Read: Retrieving and Displaying Data as printed (PDF 60, printed 56); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the topic 4.2 lesson.

blocks.text: The Read operation is used to fetch data from the database. It helps display stored records when needed. SQL select commands are commonly used for reading data. Python retrieves the results and processes them. This operation does not change the stored data.
